column1: # DEFERRED.tsv — THE ONE RECORD OF POPULATIONS LON HAS RULED DEFERRED (hq_T 2026-09-12, ceo CEO-593).
# ⛔⭐ DEFERRED IS NOT OUTSIDE-BASELINE, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT (ARCH-PROGRAM-LEDGER.md
# § DEFERRED, sovereign; this file is its machine twin, never a second authority). OUTSIDE-BASELINE says
# THE ORACLE REFUSES THIS, IT IS NOT OUR LANGUAGE — a fact about the oracle, closed forever. DEFERRED says
# THIS IS OUR LANGUAGE, WE INTEND TO BUILD IT, WE HAVE NOT, AND IT WILL NOT DEPRESS THE SCORE WHILE IT
# WAITS — a scheduling decision by Lon, and a DEBT. Collapsing the two turns an owed name into a closed one.
# ⛔⭐ WHY THIS FILE LIVES IN .github AND NOT AS A SIDECAR BESIDE EACH PACKAGE, which is where UNGRADED.tsv,
# UNGRADABLE.tsv and NARROW.tsv live. Those three record MEASUREMENTS, and the lane that measures owns them.
# A deferral is a RULING, and it LIFTS A SCORE: a row here moves programs out of the bucket that can be red.
# ⛔ So it must not be editable by the lane whose number it raises, and it must be version-controlled in the
# repo whose custody is the ceo's. One record, under review, beside SUITES.tsv — never one per package where
# the beneficiary writes it.
# ⛔ THE THREE CONDITIONS, ALL MANDATORY (ARCH-PROGRAM-LEDGER § DEFERRED). A row failing any of them is not a
# deferral, it is a FAIL wearing one, and test_gate_deferred_rows_name_a_ruling_and_the_work_they_wait_on.sh
# REFUSES rather than reporting it:
#   1. A RULING NAMES IT — `ruled_by` carries the CEO number(s), `ruled_on` the date, `ruling_verbatim` Lon's
#      own words in quotes with his name. ⛔ NO SEAT DEFERS ANYTHING ON ITS OWN JUDGEMENT, EVER.
#   2. IT IS PRINTED, NEVER SUBTRACTED IN SILENCE — `deferred=N` is the sixth PACKAGE_INVENTORY term, the
#      names print beside it, and PASS+FAIL+OUTSIDE+UNGRADABLE+UNGRADED+DEFERRED == the shipped population.
#   3. IT CARRIES THE WORK IT IS WAITING ON — `waiting_on` names the subsystem, the prerequisite and the
#      MEASURED size, so a deferral can never quietly become an abandonment.
# ⛔ `count` IS RE-MEASURED BY THE GATE AGAINST `population` ON EVERY RUN, and a disagreement REFUSES. A
# deferral whose size has drifted is the exclusion-list defect (FINDING-2026-09-09-hq_T): a name that cannot
# be red, held by a number nobody re-asked.
# population = glob relative to S4E_HOME. package = the INV_PACKAGE spelling its runner uses (or will use),
# which is the key lib_inventory.sh joins on; suite = the SUITES.tsv key, so the board and the ruling agree.
